title: phase 3: alliances service (create/invite/join/leave/kick/chat)
criteria:
Phase 3 alliances, NEW file realm/services/alliances.py (no existing file is edited). Tables already exist in realm/db/models.py: Alliance(id, world_id, name, leader_player_id, created_at), AllianceMember(player_id PK, alliance_id, role 'leader'|'member', joined_at), AllianceInvite(alliance_id, player_id, created_at; composite PK), AllianceMessage(id, alliance_id, player_id, text, created_at). Services take the session `s`, never commit (flush only), never call datetime.now (callers pass `now`), raise GameError(code, thai_message) with codes from realm.services.errors. MAX_MEMBERS = 20 (module constant).
Functions:
`create_alliance(s, player_id, name, now) -> Alliance`: player must exist and not be a bot (INVALID_TARGET 'เฉพาะผู้เล่นจริงเท่านั้น'); not already in an alliance (INVALID_TARGET 'อยู่ในพันธมิตรแล้ว'); name stripped 3..20 chars (INVALID_TARGET 'ชื่อพันธมิตรไม่ถูกต้อง'); name unique inside the player's world, case-insensitive (INVALID_TARGET 'ชื่อพันธมิตรนี้ถูกใช้แล้ว'); creates the Alliance (leader_player_id = player_id) and an AllianceMember role 'leader'; flush; return it.
`invite(s, actor_id, target_player_id, now) -> None`: actor must be the alliance leader (not in any alliance or not leader -> FORBIDDEN 'เฉพาะหัวหน้าพันธมิตร'); target must exist, same world, not a bot (INVALID_TARGET 'เฉพาะผู้เล่นจริงเท่านั้น'), not already in an alliance (INVALID_TARGET 'ผู้เล่นนี้อยู่ในพันธมิตรแล้ว'), no pending invite from this alliance (INVALID_TARGET 'เชิญไปแล้ว'); alliance not full (INVALID_TARGET 'พันธมิตรเต็มแล้ว'; members + pending invites must be < MAX_MEMBERS); creates AllianceInvite.
`accept_invite(s, player_id, alliance_id, now) -> None`: invite must exist (NOT_FOUND 'ไม่พบคำเชิญ'); player not in an alliance (INVALID_TARGET 'อยู่ในพันธมิตรแล้ว'); alliance has fewer than MAX_MEMBERS members (INVALID_TARGET 'พันธมิตรเต็มแล้ว'); adds AllianceMember role 'member', deletes ALL of the player's invites.
`decline_invite(s, player_id, alliance_id) -> None`: deletes that invite (NOT_FOUND 'ไม่พบคำเชิญ' if missing).
`leave(s, player_id, now) -> None`: must be a member (NOT_FOUND 'ไม่ได้อยู่ในพันธมิตร'); removes the membership; if the leaver was the leader and members remain, the member with the smallest (joined_at, player_id) becomes leader (role 'leader', Alliance.leader_player_id updated); if no members remain delete the alliance with its invites and messages.
`kick(s, actor_id, target_player_id) -> None`: actor must be leader (FORBIDDEN 'เฉพาะหัวหน้าพันธมิตร'); target must be a member of the same alliance (NOT_FOUND 'ไม่พบสมาชิก'); cannot kick yourself (INVALID_TARGET 'ไล่ตัวเองไม่ได้'); removes the membership.
`my_alliance(s, player_id) -> dict | None`: None when not a member, else {'id','name','leader_player_id','members': [{'player_id','name','tribe','role'}] sorted leader first then by name, 'invites': [{'player_id','name'}] (pending invites, only filled when the viewer is the leader, else [])}.
`my_invites(s, player_id) -> list[dict]`: [{'alliance_id','alliance_name','created_at'}] newest first.
`are_allies(s, a_id, b_id) -> bool`: both in the same alliance and a_id != b_id.
`post_message(s, player_id, text, now) -> AllianceMessage`: must be a member (NOT_FOUND 'ไม่ได้อยู่ในพันธมิตร'); text stripped 1..300 chars (INVALID_TARGET 'ข้อความไม่ถูกต้อง'); stores and returns it.
`list_messages(s, player_id, after_id=0, limit=50) -> list[dict]`: member only (same NOT_FOUND); messages with id > after_id, oldest first, at most `limit` newest of those; each {'id','player_id','name','text','created_at'}.
Tests tests/services/test_alliances.py (DB fixtures `s`, `cfg`, `t0`; world = worlds.create_world(s, seed=1, speed=1, player_name='ผู้เล่น', tribe='stonehold', bot_count=30, cfg=cfg, real_now=t0)); to get more human players build extra Player rows directly with real columns (copy the required columns from the existing human player: world_id, name, tribe, is_bot False, production_mult 1.0, culture_points 0, cp_updated_at, protection_until, created_at) and flush. Cover: create ok (leader member row, alliance row); create twice -> error; bot -> error; name too short/long/duplicate (different case) -> errors; invite by leader ok, by non-leader FORBIDDEN, bot target, already-member target, duplicate invite; full alliance (insert 19 member rows via direct Player + AllianceMember rows) -> 'พันธมิตรเต็มแล้ว'; accept ok removes all of the player's invites; accept without invite NOT_FOUND; accept while in an alliance error; decline; leave by member; leader leaves -> oldest member becomes leader; last member leaves -> alliance, invites and messages deleted; kick ok / non-leader FORBIDDEN / self / non-member; my_alliance for member and leader (invites visible only to leader) and None for outsider; are_allies true/false (self -> false); messages: post ok, non-member NOT_FOUND, empty/301 chars error, list_messages order, after_id filter and limit.
notes:
- Thai strings: use ONLY the exact strings quoted in criteria (copy letter by letter; proofread; Qwen often doubles tone marks or types 'บ่าน'). Do not invent other Thai.
- Real columns only in tests (check realm/db/models.py).
- New file only; never commit; never call datetime.now(); run only the test_cmd file.
